title: Utillian 6 Heating Element
description:
Includes:
2* Utillian 6 Heating Elements
2* Utillian 6 Device Base Seal

Keep Your Sessions Running Smoothly
The Utillian 6 Heating Element Pack is your essential companion for maintaining optimal performance and extending the life of your Utillian 6 Wax Pen. This pack provides you always have fresh heating elements and seals on hand, guaranteeing consistent, flavorful vapor every time.

Uninterrupted Enjoyment
Designed with convenience in mind, the Utillian 6 Heating Element Pack provides all the necessary components to keep your device running at its peak. The heating elements are the heart of your wax pen, responsible for vaporizing your concentrates. With this pack, you’ll have replacements ready to go, preventing any interruption in your vaping sessions. You can also pack and preload chambers with different concentrates so you can skip the loading process. Just swap chambers and your good to go.

Optimal Vaporization
The included base seals and mouthpiece vortex seals ensure a secure, airtight connection between the components of your Utillian 6. This prevents leaks and maintains optimal airflow for consistent vapor production and maximum flavor extraction. Additionally, these seals help direct the airflow in a way that allows the terp pearl to spin correctly, enhancing even heating and vaporization.
